Urban Warfare (Non-Sanctioned)
Urban Warfare is an above-ground hunting simulation held in a fenced area. Quarry is hidden within the brush area. The challenge is for the terrier to use natural instincts to successfully locate and work the quarry. Terrier must work to find the quarry in the shortest amount of time. The clock starts when the judge is ready and signals you to release your dog at the gate. All four paws must be on the ground before you release your dog. The judge stops the clock when your dog has found the quarry. You do not enter with the dog but you can encourage your dog verbally. No hand signals allowed. The dog must locate the quarry to have a qualifying time. Non-Sanctioned

Super Earth
A challenging GTG course with a series of false entrances and/or false tunnels and dens. Open to any Jack Russell Terrier, 6 months and older. One second per foot of tunnel to reach quarry; may leave and re-enter earth several times until the quarry is reached then must work quarry for one full minute without a break in work and without leaving quarry. May switch from one type of work to another without penalty.

Urban Warfare (Non-Sanctioned)
Urban Warfare is an above-ground hunting simulation held in a fenced area. Quarry is hidden within the brush area. The challenge is for the terrier to use natural instincts to successfully locate and work the quarry. Terrier must work to find the quarry in the shortest amount of time. The clock starts when the judge is ready and signals you to release your dog at the gate. All four paws must be on the ground before you release your dog. The judge stops the clock when your dog has found the quarry. You do not enter with the dog but you can encourage your dog verbally. No hand signals allowed. The dog must locate the quarry to have a qualifying time. Non-Sanctioned

A challenging GTG course with a series of false entrances and/or false tunnels and dens. Open to any Jack Russell Terrier, 6 months and older. One second per foot of tunnel to reach quarry; may leave and re-enter earth several times until the quarry is reached then must work quarry for one full minute without a break in work and without leaving quarry. May switch from one type of work to another without penalty.

Urban Warfare (Non-Sanctioned)
Urban Warfare is an above-ground hunting simulation held in a fenced area. Quarry is hidden within the brush area. The challenge is for the terrier to use natural instincts to successfully locate and work the quarry. Terrier must work to find the quarry in the shortest amount of time. The clock starts when the judge is ready and signals you to release your dog at the gate. All four paws must be on the ground before you release your dog. The judge stops the clock when your dog has found the quarry. You do not enter with the dog but you can encourage your dog verbally. No hand signals allowed. The dog must locate the quarry to have a qualifying time. Non-Sanctioned
